versions.changelog:
internal-comms-midea v1.1.1

- Added a new company newsletter template (examples/company-newsletter.md).
- Expanded How to use to support the newsletter template.
- Removed skill-card.md.
- Improved error handling and degradation strategy sections in SKILL.md.
- Minor wording and formatting adjustments in templates and documentation.

Version 1.1.0 of internal-comms-midea adds structured internal communication templates and workflow:

- Introduced internal document templates for various communication needs (e.g., 3P周报, 项目进展报告, 事故/异常报告, 跨部门协作邮件, FAQ等).
- Defined clear guidance on when and how to use each template.
- Standardized tone and formatting based on 美的集团规范.
- Added a glossary of common company-specific terminology.
- Outlined principles for professionalism, clarity, accountability, and collaboration in communication.
